reason: traceable-board closeout: correct BOARD-7 story wording to report-only, retarget decayed lessons, defer the review-timing escalation, and implement the two fired-trigger deferrals D-0013 (archive task-grills) and D-0014 (backfill reads PR bodies)

quality.summary: Reviewed the traceable-board closeout (lite window Q-0043). Bookkeeping is accurate: BOARD-7 ACs corrected to report-only (matching shipped behavior); the 7 decayed lessons retargeted to persistent sources (audit 9->1); 0005 exempts the reviewed-separately provenance-note category honestly. Code is minimal and correct: D-0013 archives .factory/grills/tasks/ into history then removes it, exactly mirroring plan.json's archive-then-clean lifecycle; D-0014 adds a body match with a word-boundary regex so BOARD-1 does not match BOARD-10. Both are covered by tests (lifecycle archive+clean assertions; backfill body-match + word-boundary negative). No over-engineering.

non_blocking_findings.summary: grills/tasks/ is cleaned by pr_ready at ship but not added to stale_task_state, so intake --discard-active on a crashed task won't clear it; out of D-0013's scope (ship path) and harmless (committed evidence).

performance.summary: No hot-path impact. D-0014 adds one field (body) to the existing single `gh pr list` call and one precompiled regex search per record — negligible. D-0013 copytree/rmtree a small per-task grills dir once at ship. The lesson retargets are static JSON edits. No fanout, amplification, or memory churn.

security.summary: Net safety-positive. D-0013 preserves per-task grill evidence into history (evidence lifetime 0025) instead of leaving it to rot in the live tree, and removes it only after the copy. D-0014's body match uses a word-boundary regex on re.escape(key), so it cannot over-match a longer key (BOARD-1 vs BOARD-10) or be injected by body content. No new trust boundary, no secret exposure, no unsafe default. The 0005 exemption is a policy clause with no code path.
